claude_code.supported_min_source: the .claude-plugin/marketplace.json schema this catalog ships has been stable since 2.0.0; the previous floor was never validated
claude_code.verification_method: Real direct CLI check this run — `claude --version` on the runner reports 2.1.246, closing the gap the prior two runs left between `validated_against` (stuck at 2.1.241) and `latest_known` (advanced to 2.1.245 by changelog review only). `claude plugin validate --strict .agents/skills` was re-run against this live 2.1.246 CLI and passed clean, and `claude plugin marketplace add`-style catalog resolution was re-checked via `make validate` (regenerate + validate manifests; 3 plugins in sync, no drift). The 2.1.246 changelog delta was reviewed line-by-line against the catalog surface: an Auto mode `/permissions` tab, a plugin-cache duplicate-SHA-directory fix, a `claude plugin update <name>` bare-name fix, hook-error `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` resolution, an MCP `requiresUserInteraction` permission-prompt fix, subagent partial-output-on-maxTurns, deferred managed-settings consent prompts, and OTel `plugin_id_hash`/`enabled_via` changes are all host/CLI-side with no marketplace-manifest surface. Three items got a direct compatibility check against this repo: (1) the plugin.json UTF-8 BOM install-breaking bug — every JSON manifest in this repo (`.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, `.cursor-plugin/marketplace.json`, `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json`) starts with a bare `{` byte, no BOM, confirmed with `od -An -tx1`; this catalog ships no `plugin.json` of its own (its three plugins are external repos) so there was nothing to fix either way; (2) the `/reload-plugins` fix for plugins whose skills live under `skills/*/SKILL.md` — this catalog's own contributor skill is at `.agents/skills/run-plugins-catalog/SKILL.md`, a bare skills directory rather than a Claude Code plugin's `skills/` tree, so the bug this fixes never applied here; (3) the skill-frontmatter `<plugin>:` name-doubling fix — this catalog's skill frontmatter `name: run-plugins-catalog` carries no plugin prefix, so it was never affected. Prior verification still holds: catalog install previously verified with `claude plugin marketplace add Tamircohen28/tamirs-marketplace` followed by `claude plugin install <name>@tamirs-marketplace`. 2.1.238's `headersHelper` for url marketplaces and catalog/archive entries remains documented in the install guide's plugin-sources section — this catalog's `github`-source entries need no auth so nothing in `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` changed

opencode.supported_min_source: oldest version on which `skills.paths` discovery of a catalog plugin's skills was verified with `opencode debug skill`
opencode.verification_method: opencode --version on the maintainer machine; latest from registry.npmjs.org/opencode-ai. OpenCode has no marketplace, so the catalog itself cannot be installed — each plugin repo is cloned and its skills verified with `opencode debug skill`

capability_gaps.marketplace: OpenCode has no plugin marketplace and no plugin manifest, so this catalog cannot be added as an install source. Each plugin repo is installed directly — clone it and point `skills.paths` at its `skills/` directory, or symlink it into the OpenCode skills directory. Every plugin in this catalog ships its own `opencode.json` and its own OpenCode install guide.
capability_gaps.catalog_discovery: There is no OpenCode equivalent of listing plugins from a remote catalog. The plugin table in this repo's README is the discovery surface; installation is then per-repo.
